scope: Bounded Stage 4 faculty review for the eight routes newly advanced by Stage 3 re-entry 16. Each retained lead has a current appointment, exact-program supervision evidence, strong TerraProbe/Evidex overlap, and recent-work or active-project evidence. Four additional current-roster candidates per route are encoded separately in professor_mapping.py and remain unscored unless they clear every evidence gate.
